The user wants me to add a line to notes/testing.md about running a single test file, then verify the file reads well.

The tests use Node's built-in test runner (per README). To run a single test file with Node's built-in test runner, you'd do `node --test test/something.test.js` or `node --test path/to/file.test.js`.

I checked the test directory and found test/add.test.js. Then I read notes/testing.md, which had:
- npm install
- npm test
- npm run lint

I added the line for running a single test file, then re-read the file to confirm:
- npm install — install dependencies
- npm test — run unit tests (test/, Node test runner)
- node --test test/<file>.test.js — run a single test file
- npm run lint — lint before committing

That reads well. I should give a brief summary of what I did.
